description: Turns a script into a hand-drawn Alpy video narrated by an AI voice. The script is the spoken narration only, 110-2700 words (write it first with write_youtube_script if needed). Returns a video id; poll get_video every minute or so. Confirm the creator authorizes spending their existing minutes before calling. A creator with enough video minutes gets the full video straight away, which spends those minutes; otherwise their one free 10-second preview is made first. At most 10 a day. Needs a connected Alpy account or an Alpy API key.

captions.description: Burn captions into the video. Cannot be removed afterwards.

character_source.description: Where that character is from, as list_characters says.

script.description: The narration, exactly as it should be spoken.

name: create_video

next.description: What to do next, in words.
